scope: Exactly original NextQA rows0..199; four conditions; no VATEX or automatic expansion

paired_WUPS.estimand: Similarity minus random; bootstrap over source-video clusters, conditional on fixed seeds 0,1,2

bootstrap.pairing: Same cluster draws for all conditions, conditional on fixed random seeds 0,1,2

metric: Unchanged native NextQA WUPS@0 aggregate in 0-100 points; negative paired differences are retained
interpretation: Hybrid Global Random-head changes head identities and layer allocation under the same 56-of-112 global quota and unchanged native per-head retained budgets. Three seeds are not additional independent inputs; seed sample SD and input-cluster CI describe different uncertainty. This prefix alone does not establish general superiority.

generation_contract.intervention: Only global head identities change. Native classification and every per-head retained budget stay fixed. Total candidate expansion/removal may change with the identities of heterogeneous-budget heads.
generation_contract.input_policy: Original first-prefix order; one CPU preparation, identical tensors for four conditions; no persistent tensor cache
